declared_purpose: Connect a Claude subscription to Clawdbot by copying Keychain OAuth credentials into its auth profiles and maintaining them through expiry-aware refresh, scheduled every two hours, with optional notifications. Keychain synchronization and gateway restart are documented behavior; discovery breadth, recipient selection, diagnostic contents and retention are implementation choices (SKILL.md:1-15, 49-65, 182-192).

data_operations.source: User-invoked Claude CLI and browser login
data_operations.data_scope: Authentication information and resulting credentials; the login exchange is not supplied.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Claude CLI/browser and their unspecified authentication services
data_operations.condition: The documented setup requires Claude CLI to be logged in before installation.

data_operations.operation: Read configuration and inspect setup locally
data_operations.source: Runtime configuration, auth-profiles.json, OS and CLI version/status commands
data_operations.data_scope: Refresh settings, notification target, credential-store selectors, profile name, endpoint, file paths, software versions and setup status
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local script processes; verification output returns to its caller.
data_operations.condition: Refresh reads configuration when present and otherwise applies defaults. Verification performs checks when preceding checks allow execution to continue.

data_operations.operation: Enumerate Keychain metadata and read candidate credential items
data_operations.source: security dump-keychain and service/account-specific security find-generic-password calls
data_operations.data_scope: Keychain metadata is filtered for matching service account names. Candidate item passwords, containing OAuth JSON and metadata, are read until a qualifying item is found.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local shell variables and Python parsers; enumeration itself supplies no remote recipient.
data_operations.condition: Refresh requires refreshToken and expiresAt. Verification separately reads candidates and checks for refreshToken. Both choose the first qualifying candidate in their iteration.

data_operations.operation: Infer a notification destination from session metadata
data_operations.data_scope: Direct-session classification, deliveryContext.channel, deliveryContext.to or lastTo; channel-specific target normalization
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Detector process and its caller through channel|target output
data_operations.condition: Requires jq and the sessions file. Selects the first direct session with delivery context. Despite documentation, this executable does not read clawdbot.json contents or search Telegram messages.

data_operations.operation: Display and persist notification settings; migrate old configuration
data_operations.source: Detector output, interactive preferences and existing configuration
data_operations.data_scope: Channel, target identifier, success/failure preferences and other retained configuration fields
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Installer caller and package-local claude-oauth-refresh-config.json; preview and verification callers also receive detected identifiers.
data_operations.condition: Installer attempts detection before deciding whether to keep existing settings. New configuration stores detected values or a placeholder. Migration rewrites and removes, or renames, the old configuration. Detection preview compares settings without writing configuration.

data_operations.source: Selected Keychain expiresAt and local clock
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Refresh process, caller and activity logs
data_operations.condition: A valid selected credential is required. Without --force, remaining time greater than the buffer bypasses the OAuth request and exits after possible local synchronization.

data_operations.source: Selected Keychain refreshToken and configured client_id
data_operations.data_scope: refresh_token, client_id and grant_type; response access_token, refresh_token and expires_in
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: TOKEN_URL, defaulting to https://console.anthropic.com/v1/oauth/token; response returns to the local refresh process.
data_operations.condition: Runs when expiry is within the configured buffer or --force is supplied. The request has a 30-second timeout. Existing access tokens, account names and subscription metadata are not included in the constructed request.

data_operations.operation: Read and atomically rewrite the Clawdbot credential store
data_operations.source: Existing AUTH_FILE and selected or refreshed OAuth credentials
data_operations.data_scope: Existing auth-store contents; selected profile access, refresh, expires, type and provider; Anthropic order and lastGood
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Temporary file in the auth directory, renamed to AUTH_FILE; default ~/.clawdbot/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json
data_operations.condition: For a still-valid credential, writes only when accessToken exists and differs from the stored access value. After successful refresh, writes unconditionally. Normally preserves unrelated profiles; invalid or unreadable existing content falls back to an empty store and can be replaced. Script default profile is anthropic:claude-cli; the example configuration selects anthropic:default.

data_operations.operation: Reconstruct and replace the selected Keychain item
data_operations.source: New OAuth credentials and metadata from the original selected item
data_operations.data_scope: New accessToken, refreshToken and expiresAt; retained scopes, subscriptionType and rateLimitTier, or fallback defaults. These defaults are synthesized values, not verified entitlement inferences.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Selected KEYCHAIN_SERVICE/KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT item in local Keychain
data_operations.condition: After the auth-file update, deletes the old item and adds the reconstructed JSON. Fields outside the reconstructed structure are omitted.

data_operations.source: Refresh log calls and captured Clawdbot command output
data_operations.data_scope: Timestamps, candidate and selected account names, expiry times, file paths, status and errors; certain failures include all candidate account names or the raw OAuth response.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: LOG_FILE and caller stdout through tee; scheduled stdout is additionally stored in claude-oauth-refresher-stdout.log. Notification and gateway command output also append to LOG_FILE.
data_operations.condition: Logging occurs on reached refresh paths. Raw response logging occurs when parsed OAuth JSON lacks access_token. No packaged rotation or retention limit is shown.

data_operations.data_scope: Refresh outcome; success includes expiry and estimated next refresh. Failure may include account names or a raw OAuth response.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: clawdbot message send with NOTIFY_TARGET; ultimate channel, recipient resolution and provider storage are unspecified by supplied source.
data_operations.condition: Requires an installed clawdbot command and a nonempty, non-placeholder target. The command receives no notification_channel. Boolean false notification settings become true through jq // true, so ordinary boolean disabling does not suppress delivery. The still-valid early-exit path sends no success notification.

data_operations.operation: Persist scheduled execution and delegate gateway restart
data_operations.data_scope: Script/home paths, working directory, PATH, schedule and output-log destinations; gateway restart command
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Package-local plist and ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.clawdbot.claude-oauth-refresher.plist; local launchd and Clawdbot gateway
data_operations.condition: Installer tests refresh, creates and loads a job that runs at load and every 7200 seconds. After a successful actual refresh, an available Clawdbot command is scheduled to restart the gateway; its output is logged.

data_operations.source: Documented auth-profile status and Keychain debugging commands
data_operations.data_scope: The entire selected OAuth profile, including access and refresh credentials; the Keychain debugging command requests the item password.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Terminal or invoking agent/tool caller; no automatic external publication is specified.
data_operations.condition: Only when the user or agent follows these diagnostic instructions.

data_operations.operation: Request manual disclosure of support diagnostics
data_operations.source: Verification output, relevant log excerpts and configuration
data_operations.data_scope: Setup diagnostics, potentially account names or raw response contents from logs, and configuration with notification_target redacted
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Audience of the support issue the user opens; host and visibility are not specified.
data_operations.condition: The upgrade guide recommends this only if troubleshooting remains unsuccessful. No automatic upload is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Stop execution and conditionally delete local artifacts
data_operations.source: Installed service, plist files, default logs and configuration files
data_operations.data_scope: Scheduled job, execution paths, logged diagnostics and notification preferences/identifiers
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local launchd and filesystem deletion boundaries
data_operations.condition: Uninstaller unloads the service and removes both plist copies. Default logs and old/new configurations are deleted only after affirmative prompts. Scripts and Keychain credentials remain; no auth-profile deletion is implemented. Custom LOG_FILE locations are outside its fixed cleanup list.

potential_excess.data_scope: Metadata for unrelated Keychain items during repeated discovery
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local security dump-keychain output and the refresh/verification processing pipeline
potential_excess.condition: Both components enumerate Keychain metadata before filtering for the required service, including on subsequent runs.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Find a complete Claude OAuth credential across possibly multiple matching accounts; the global metadata sweep is an implementation choice.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Locate and validate a usable service/account item, retaining fallback discovery for missing or incomplete candidates.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Allow or remember the selected account and try its service-scoped lookup first; reserve broad enumeration for failed or unresolved discovery.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Revalidate the credential and fall back when the remembered item disappears, becomes incomplete or the user changes accounts. Initial multi-account discovery may remain necessary.

potential_excess.data_scope: Session metadata and inferred notification identifiers
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Detector/verification/installer processes, their caller output and newly written configuration
potential_excess.condition: Verification can run detection, then installer runs it again before checking existing configuration or collecting notification preferences.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Obtain a destination when creating or explicitly changing enabled notification settings.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Detect once, after determining that destination configuration is needed; reuse that result and skip detection when retaining a valid destination or disabling all notifications.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep an explicit preview/reconfiguration path and manual configuration fallback. Correct boolean preference handling so disabling notifications is effective.

potential_excess.data_scope: Entire success or failure notification, target identifier and refresh activity
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: clawdbot message send and the recipient resolved from NOTIFY_TARGET
potential_excess.condition: A user sets notifications.on_success or notifications.on_failure to boolean false, but jq // true changes it to true; a usable target and clawdbot command exist.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Notifications are explicitly optional and documented as individually disableable.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Deliver only the notification types the user enables.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Apply defaults only to missing/null fields and preserve boolean false. Suppress the entire disabled send rather than merely trimming its message.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep enabled notifications, default behavior for absent settings and the existing empty-target suppression.

potential_excess.data_scope: Refresh outcomes, expiry times and failure diagnostics potentially sent to an unintended destination
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: NOTIFY_TARGET passed to clawdbot message send; notification_channel is stored but omitted from delivery.
potential_excess.condition: The first direct session is not the intended notification recipient, or target-only routing does not resolve to the stored channel. Actual misdelivery cannot be established from supplied source.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Notify the user about their connection; selecting an arbitrary first direct session does not establish recipient ownership.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Deliver enabled notifications to the user's intended channel and target.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Confirm or explicitly configure the destination before its first use, validate it, and bind delivery to the configured channel using a supported routing mechanism.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain automatic destination suggestions and supported channel formats. Clawdbot routing behavior must be resolved before prescribing its exact invocation.

potential_excess.data_scope: Candidate and selected Keychain account names, including the complete candidate list on failure
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: LOG_FILE, caller stdout, scheduled stdout log and, for the complete-failure message, the Clawdbot notification target
potential_excess.condition: Candidate checking and selection log account identifiers. If no candidate qualifies, error_exit logs and optionally sends the account list.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Report credential-discovery progress and actionable authentication failures.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Indicate whether credentials were found and explain how to authenticate again.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use counts or nonidentifying candidate references in routine logs and notifications; expose account names only through an explicitly requested local diagnostic.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep enough local context to distinguish duplicate or incomplete entries without automatically persisting or messaging their names.

potential_excess.data_scope: Entire OAuth response body, potentially including a refresh credential or other sensitive response fields
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: LOG_FILE, stdout/scheduled stdout log and the configured Clawdbot notification destination
potential_excess.condition: Valid parsed OAuth JSON lacks access_token. The response can still contain refresh_token or other fields; actual contents are unknown.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Record and optionally notify an actionable failure reason.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Replace raw-response interpolation with an allowlisted, sanitized error code/message and missing-field description.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain useful provider error classification without including credentials or arbitrary response fields. This narrows data in a required failure action rather than removing failure reporting.

potential_excess.data_scope: Repeated timestamped refresh diagnostics, including account identifiers and expiry history
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: LOG_FILE and duplicate scheduled stdout persistence
potential_excess.condition: log() appends through tee, while launchd separately persists stdout. The package supplies no rotation limit; uninstall retains logs by default and does not cover custom log paths.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep useful recent diagnostic history and capture failures.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use one primary persistent activity stream, bound its retention, and make cleanup aware of the configured log path.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve stderr and failure evidence needed for diagnosis; account for any externally managed rotation before changing retention.

potential_excess.data_scope: Access and refresh credential values displayed during status/debug checks
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Terminal or invoking agent/tool caller; no further disclosure is established.
potential_excess.condition: The documented full-profile or password-displaying diagnostic commands are followed.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Check OAuth profile format, credential availability and connection status.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Show profile type/provider, expiry and credential-presence indicators; identify matching Keychain items.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Project nonsecret fields and credential-presence booleans; use metadata-only Keychain inspection for ordinary debugging.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain verification of OAuth field names and token availability without returning credential values.

potential_excess.data_scope: Account identifiers and potentially sensitive response contents in support diagnostics
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Audience of the manually opened support issue; host and visibility remain unspecified.
potential_excess.condition: The user follows the support instructions and submits verification output or log excerpts containing these fields. Only notification_target redaction is expressly requested.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Help diagnose setup or refresh failures.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Provide relevant software/setup state, sanitized error classification and minimal configuration.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Request an allowlisted diagnostic summary and redact account identifiers, credentials and raw provider responses before submission.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep issue-specific error context. Do not treat this manual recommendation as an automatic upload.

unknowns: Recipient resolution is blocked by missing Clawdbot implementation: target-only routing, actual messaging provider, recipient identity, provider retention and command-output contents cannot be established.
The deployed configuration and Keychain contents are absent. Actual endpoint, credential account, notification destination, custom paths and response contents therefore remain conditional.
OAuth-server processing, retention, returned credential scopes and error-body contents are undocumented in the supplied implementation.
Initial browser authentication, Clawdbot gateway behavior and external CLI internals are outside the supplied source; their additional reads, transmissions and persistence remain unresolved.
Whether reconstructed Keychain metadata and fallback subscription/rate-tier values are required for Claude CLI compatibility is unknown. Removing them cannot be recommended unconditionally.
No packaged retention limit is shown, but external log rotation, backups and filesystem access policies are unknown. Support-issue visibility and retention are also unspecified.

README.md:1-20 declares native replacement and deprecation, while CHANGELOG.md:5-12 describes renewed OAuth functionality. Native equivalence is unverified, so the entire skill cannot be classified as redundant from these claims.
Reported validation success does not establish runtime privacy behavior. This audit covers supplied source paths; no commands or external implementations were executed or inspected.
